title: Hazel and the Letters
author: Lior Amberdale
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
